name: Lightning Resource Corp.
summary: Lightning Resource Corp. engages in the exploration and evaluation of mineral properties in Canada, Zambia, and Japan. It primarily focuses on base and precious metal deposits. The company has an option agreement to acquire approximately 72% interest in the Pangeni copper project in Zambia, holds an 80% interest in the Kazan Gold Project in Japan, and a 100% interest in the Savant Gold Exploration Project in northwestern Ontario, Canada.
